content: fluent-ffmpeg's GitHub repo was archived May 22, 2025 and no longer works correctly with recent ffmpeg versions; FFmpegKit was also archived and had binaries pulled from package registries April 2025. The 2025/2026 standard replacement is to spawn the ffmpeg binary directly via Node's child_process.spawn (or the execa wrapper for promise-based ergonomics/better error handling), constructing the argv array manually instead of relying on a fluent DSL.
